dashboard.name: Business Growth
dashboard.description: Did support move the needle? Growth is measured against the revenue captured at enrolment, not against business size.

cards.name: Revenue growth by sector
cards.description: Average and median growth, so one runaway business cannot carry a sector.
cards.sql:
select sector,
       round(avg(avg_revenue_growth_pct), 2) as avg_growth_pct,
       round(avg(median_revenue_growth_pct), 2) as median_growth_pct,
       sum(businesses_reporting) as businesses
from mart_business_growth
group by sector
order by avg_growth_pct desc

cards.name: Revenue and profit by month
cards.description: Absolute performance of the businesses reporting each month.
cards.sql:
select period, sum(revenue_usd) as revenue_usd, sum(profit_usd) as profit_usd
from mart_business_growth
group by period
order by period

cards.name: Share of businesses growing
cards.description: Breadth rather than size: how many businesses are growing at all.
cards.sql:
select period, country_iso3, round(avg(growing_share_pct), 2) as growing_share_pct
from mart_business_growth
group by period, country_iso3
order by period

cards.name: Jobs and customers by sector
cards.description: What each sector supports beyond its own revenue.
cards.sql:
select sector,
       sum(businesses_reporting) as businesses,
       sum(jobs_supported) as jobs_supported,
       sum(customers_served) as customers_served,
       round(sum(revenue_usd), 2) as revenue_usd
from mart_business_growth
group by sector
order by revenue_usd desc
